supersedes.reason: The treatment collector now searches bounded sibling Cypress pageobjects directories and recognizes additional literal Cypress action forms. V1 cases and outcomes cannot be pooled with V2.

hypothesis: With identical reviewer and source context, mandatory exact-selector ownership leads from sibling Cypress support/pageobjects roots improve stable #13 recall for named cypress/e2e specs without additional stable #13 false alarms.
claim_scope: Public-development evidence for one Codex host/model and the named Cypress-spec workflow only; not Playwright, directory reviews, a sealed release result, or whole-skill superiority.

arms.control: A copy of the treatment skill with only the #13 automatic lead collector, invocation, and point-of-use lead instructions removed; the #13 semantic ownership rule remains identical.
arms.treatment: The current skill with automatic candidate-only #13 leads from regular sibling support/pageobjects directories.
arms.freeze: Archive exact arm trees, ablation diff, and SHA-256 digests before measured calls; reject unrelated differences. scripts/evals/make-pom-ownership-control.py is a builder, not a substitute for inspecting its output.

case_selection.primary_layout: One named Cypress spec under cypress/e2e/ with complete relevant regular cypress/support/ or cypress/pageobjects/ source available.
case_selection.unit: One independently owned interaction workflow or clean control, clustered by repository; repeated call sites and paired repairs are not independent defects.
case_selection.positive_label: A raw spec action bypasses a source-proven existing equivalent Page Object method, locator, duplicated workflow, or explicit ownership convention; record the first bypassing action and owning source anchors.
case_selection.negative_label: No source-proven ownership of that action, including same-selector different-purpose actions, read-only assertions, intentional diagnostic canaries, and non-equivalent helpers.
case_selection.exclusions: Exclude Appsmith, the seven repositories in ../pom-ownership-v1/hard-cases.json, every other source inspected during collector development, authored positive mutants, unavailable source closure, ambiguous labels, and duplicate workflows from the primary analysis.
case_selection.selection_policy: Record all source-screened candidates and exclusions before model calls. Do not select by scanner or model output. Paired repairs are controlled negatives, not natural positive defects.

labeling.rule: Two independent reviewers inspect pinned source without arm output; reconcile disagreements before freezing. If neither is human, call labels model-adjudicated, not human ground truth.
labeling.freeze: Pin source commits, source closure hashes, case manifest, labels, scorer, arm digests, runner identity, schedule seed, and this protocol digest before measured calls. A later change requires a new study version.

execution.prompt: General read-only E2E test-quality review; do not mention #13, Page Objects, expected label, or study arm.
execution.schedule: Deterministic seeded, repository-balanced arm order; fresh session and workspace per call; no cross-call memory.
execution.input_controls: Equal source snapshots, tools, context budget, timeout, and runner-version policy apart from the pinned skill trees; block access to labels, other cells, and ambient checkout files.
execution.incomplete: Any missing source, failed scanner invocation, changed staged digest, identity/isolation fault, exhausted infrastructure retry, or unscoreable output makes the matrix INCOMPLETE.

scoring.stable_prediction: A source-anchored #13 finding in at least 2 of 3 scoreable repetitions, citing the first bypassing action and Page Object ownership evidence.
scoring.primary: Paired difference in stable #13 recall across unique positive workflows, treatment minus control; resample repositories as clusters for a 95% interval.
scoring.guards: No additional stable #13 alarms on repaired or independent clean cases; separately adjudicate newly reported non-#13 findings.
scoring.secondary: Input, cached input, output and billed tokens if available; model-call and end-to-end time; scanner time, completion rate, and cost per additional unique stable #13 detection.
scoring.decision: SUPPORT only with at least 20-point stable #13 recall gain, a repository-clustered 95% interval lower bound above zero, gains in at least three repositories, and zero additional stable #13 guard alarms. Otherwise FAIL if complete and contrary, or INCONCLUSIVE if incomplete or too imprecise.
scoring.cost_policy: Report cost and latency deltas; do not claim efficiency without a separately registered acceptable cost ceiling. Token counters alone do not establish billed cost; use the applicable uncached-input, cached-input, and output rates.

stage_gates.feasibility: No model comparison until 20 fresh natural positive workflows from at least ten repositories and independently adjudicated paired/clean controls exist. If scarce, narrow the claim instead of filling quotas with development cases or mutants.
stage_gates.pipeline_pilot: A disjoint 12-input pilot may test staging, digests, tool invocation, scoring, and cost only; never promote pilot cases into the confirmatory set.
stage_gates.confirmatory: Run 60 inputs by 2 arms by 3 repetitions (360 calls) only after a cost estimate and explicit budget cap. Stop INCOMPLETE on integrity faults, not unfavorable scores.
stage_gates.extension: A second model, Playwright, or directory-review workflow requires a separate preregistered matrix.
